name: Oil of Etherealness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 10 minutes to apply: the Etherealness spell for 1 hour on a Medium or smaller creature.
text: This cloudy gray oil beads on the outside of its vial and evaporates almost at once. Spending 10 minutes rubbing it over a creature of Medium size or smaller, together with its worn and carried gear, puts that creature under Etherealness (as the spell) for 1 hour. Each size category above Medium needs one additional vial.
